title: OT-2 PCR Prep: Master Mix Distribution and DNA Transfer
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Master Mix Distribution and DNA Transfer](./pcr_prep_part_

This protocol allows your robot to distribute a master mix solution from well A1 of a trough to PCR strips. Robot will then transfer DNA samples to the master mix solution. --- You will need: * [12-channel reservoir](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx) * [96-well PCR plate](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601)
Input the number of samples you are processing.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter sample count
steps.instruction: Input the number of samples you are processing into the OT‑2 interface.

steps.title: Select pipettes
steps.instruction: Choose the pipette(s) you will use for the run in the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Specify volumes
steps.instruction: Enter the desired master‑mix volume and DNA volume to be added to each well.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the 12‑channel reservoir, 96‑well PCR plate, and any tip racks in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT‑2 App (use calibration tips as described in the support article).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to begin the protocol.

steps.title: Distribute master mix
steps.instruction: The robot will dispense master‑mix solution from well A1 of the trough to the PCR strips located in slot 2.

steps.title: Transfer DNA samples
steps.instruction: The robot will transfer DNA from the PCR strips in slot 1 to the master‑mix‑containing wells in slot 2.
